answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a river as the anchor of the cost. A zephyr stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a ripple...
